book.name: Taato Langaah
book.title: Va sen Kalisi taato langaah vu Jon-ato

content: + o 4:1 Taato 1:1,10*Lung laa tonde sim saahe de vinavi ti neep natok vu baandoni, tombe lava sen sa hango nêêl vakasin vu sa nyendoos nambe sen vuuk suu-to, ond yik nêêl laah nambe, “Ganaam baandong-anjo in sa taato va pin sen le naatok naam vu taamusin-ato vu hong.”
+ o 4:2 Saam 47:8; Ais 6:1; Esi 1:26; Taato 19:4*Om yik pavis atombe Vavi Vaambuung hôôvu sa lôôt, tombe saahe omaaho ti nando lak sia lulemak-ate vu baandoni.

+ o 4:3 Esi 1:28*Ke, saahe omaaho sen nando baandonii-ju ond ni nambe tatuuh amengali-ngali valôôy osin nihees, tonde saahe de bumbanjiing ti natêêlang nambe tatuuh amengali sen niluuh-ato be hambuuh omaahôô-ju osin yite sia lulemak-ate tatup.

+ o 4:4 Ais 24:23; Taato 3:18; 6:11*Tonde saahe de yêêv doo-ti be laam yumbeyuuh dando lak sia lulemak-ate ti ti be lambuuh omaahôô-ju tatup, tombe yêêv-asôônju ond lalop lolop valôôy osin laanggin silate taambuuh gool lulemak-ate lakando lund.

+ o 4:5 Taato 1:4; 8:5; 11:19; 16:18; Esi 1:13*Tonde demak navêêl osin lavand heey nalaam de kalang natuuh vu sen lulemak-ate sia nandôô-juuto, tonde kin tumin namaavaalu be vindak yuuh natum laah hato sia mekaalus. Ke, tombe kin namaavaalu be vindak yuuh-anju ond lohvu Anutu-te Vavi Vaambuung sen saahe lohvu nôôn namaavaalu be vindak yuuh-ato.

+ o 4:6 Esi 1:5-10,22; 10:14*De taaku sen neep laah osin lulemak-ate sia mêê-to, ond vati nambe sen lôôy bopaata ti neep-ato ond yoo neep melangaah-ambe mengali lôôt nambe sen dundum-ato. Va metumin yumbeyuuh daale be lambuuh siaa-ju tatup. Ke, va metumin yumbeyuuh-anju mend kaalus ngeeyaata vu tapumin sil damband osin sil damind.

Va metumin-asôônju ond tik ni nambe voow bamaan layon, tonde ango sen tu yuuh ond ni nambe kao moow, tonde ti sen tu yaal ond mekaalus lohvu omaahonôôn amend, tonde ti sen tu yumbeyuuh ond ni nambe tuungg sen navêêhin baandonii-to.

+ o 4:8 Ais 6:2-3; Esi 1:18; 10:12; Taato 1:4,8*Ke, va metumin yumbeyuuh-anju ond sil ti ti yoo bees namaavaalu vindak ti lohvu sil pin, tombe sil amend kaalus ngeeyaata vu tapumin sil anind naavi osin sil alondpayo having. Tombe busin-ande langaah ond yoo mondanêêl nambe,

content.text: “Omaaho Bop Anutu sen niwêêk danggakook-ato Omaaho Vaambuung, Omaaho Vaambuung, Omaaho Vaambuung. Yoo nando vu nyendoos-ambe nando gêên-anjo, tombe sim taamusin ond le naam.”

content: Ke, yoo mondanêêl-ande me-datôômin e, yik yoo mondanêêl vakasin nambêênjo lôôt.

+ o 4:9 Taato 19:4; Dan 4:34; 6:26; Dan 12:7*Ke, tonde Anutu sen nando lak sia lulemak-atêêto yoo nando in mando metumin danggata osin danggata, ond va metumin-asôônju daanêêl yite nikaapulis langaah osin gako haale jak-ambe daapêêlis na vu.

+ o 4:10 Taato 5:1,7,13; 6:16; 7:10,15; 19:4; 21:5*Ond pavis atombe yêêv doo-ti be laam yumbeyuuh-ato gato pataav baambund nanjip voon-ambe lanohak vu Anutu sen nando lak sia lulemak-ate be nando danggata-têêto, osin gatung silate taambuuh gool lulemak-ate na mando ngaaho hôôk me, yik yoo mondawiing nambêênjo lak busin pin, tonde danêêl nambe,

content.text: “O Omaaho Bop heyate Anutu, hong ond mem ganivasa lôôt lohvu nambe omaahonôôn daanêêl gate nikaapulis langaah osin sil gako ohaalem jak, tonde sil lavand dôôk hong in gate niwêêk, in goo hatung va pin lohvu gakam, tombe yik gêên va pin nôôn ak-ambe nando.”
